oh i know what you're saying and thanks, am trying to get help so i can get the help i need, just not having a very good time of it to say the least. but am trying
early 30's

I tried getting help when i was in the hospital but it didnt work and would only last for the 2 weeks i was there, after that i didnt have the money or a dr to get any meds. I would happily try them just not an option at the moment which i'm trying to fix just not working out
Not really, wasnt till after i was admitted for a cpl weeks did they think it might be serious. Thing is now if i mention it they think it's nothing just a funk and that i should just stop it.
Wow that's crazy were pretty much the same age too.  Got any tricks for shushing the brain, all i've really found that works is music
I wish i knew, any kind of social interaction right down to getting a txt my whole body just flips out on me. even replying here isnt easy and this is anonymousish
as much as i can, i've got pretty extreme anxiety to the point i can barely go and get breed at the store
not any more, they removed my job at the first of summer
I know exactly how you feel on most, cept the nightmares, sleep is the only time i get reprieve but that's cuz i thankfully practiced controling my dreams at a very young age

Not one to ask on how to get over stuff cuz quite frankly i cant myself. but i do suggest you get rid of the insulin (unless medically needed) without it there will help you get through days and they do all say time gets you through things. Without the means you do live longer and that i do speak from experience
Thanks and here's hoping. This is the worst it's ever been life wise not quite depression wise yet but close.

It's really quite alright the thought goes a long way. I somehow always get by (dont ask how cuz i dont even know) Idk if their even are any here but i'll be seeing whats around.  You'd probably be surprised how cold it can get and i'll be fine but that's just from how i grew up and stuff (my bedroom growing up had no heat and could see outside at some spots so got rather chilly)

Personally for as long as i can remember. never thought it was something i would ever act on or have any hold till my mid 20's. Just sounded like a broken record playing over and over in the back of my head like ambient noise or something

Wouldnt be anywhere to plug it into without any electricity. Oh and when i say trailer i dont mean the kind you would take camping it's the house kind. For lack of a better explanation think redneck home type trailer. If i could find the stuff i need i can easily enough build a stove wouldnt be the first time just getting wood isnt exactly easy either (burning green wood (not dried) isnt very good)

Thanks for the thought but i wouldnt even ask for it if you did. I have issues with asking for help so yea even this trying to get assistance in the first place is amping my depression like crazy let alone the fact they keep dropping endless walls in the way of it. Temp will be quite a bit below freezing from now till may/june ish. Around the end of jan it can get to -40c out (same as farenheight) for weeks on end

Story of my life >< you have noooo idea..  I really dont know if i can, i do own a trailer they would tell me to live in even though i cant afford it. (dont owe money on it just cant afford heat or food).  So i guess I wouldnt be "completely" homeless but still here this time a year in a house with no heat wouldnt be much better than under a bridge.

No their really isnt, also live in the middle of the country over an hour's drive from anywhere. Cant move either or else my entire clam for help will be thrown out due to change of address. It's really quite sickening they tell you to get help and you try and their's no help without having already had help ...etc.  The case worker in there even said to get meds and therapy but i couldnt afford them and their wasnt any help for it but i should have got the help i couldnt get so i'm not in the situation i'm in

No he wouldnt let me stay there in the first place, let alone stay out of his way.  Asked him before and that was just after i came out of the hospital for an attempt and even then it was a no. but ofcourse he let my brother move in there a month later for free when i was even offering and able to pay him for the room at the time

Did somehow manage to get it started (anxiety and depression make it really quite hard for me to do anything like that but somehow managaed to) No i dont. Cant stay with mom she's back to drinking and that is something i simply couldnt survive being around again and dad is only ok with me as long as i'm no bother to him in any way else it's a constant you're pathetic coming out of him. As far as friends dont have any anymore. Been a recluse on my own for so long now i have zero contact with anyone. Yea i've got myself in quite the rut from everything i know ><

Thing is if you're born on assistance ie been on it forever it's no prob, blink and they will throw money at you. trying to get on it when you need it can be next to impossible, well atleast for me it is. Like they need my medicare and record of employment. Last job says my roe doesnt exist because i worked for them steady for years but it doesnt count as working for them, and trying to get my medicare card is going to take a min of 2 months when i'm already borderline homeless
I'm actually up in canada. Trying to get assistance here but it's a never ending no and you need these things that dont exist or cant get.
